Seats/aisle rails remain schematic; interior gallery lacked architectural context.

changes: Added running-bond brick mapping across 70 vertical masonry faces, so facade material variation reads consistently around the shell. The design still follows qualitative imagery, not a measured elevation.
Retained raised roof seams and color/roughness detail as visible surface variation. No new roof profile or height claim was made because no calibrated supporting source was found.
Kept a reduced, centered entry name sign whose model width is an explicit visual estimate, not a measurement.

Refined the seat silhouette with small edge bevels and the R4 schematic center aisle. Retained 288 representative seats, 12 center-aisle treads and 24 split tier sections; exact seating/circulation remains unknown.

Added a separate `AQUA_R5_Context | approximate site dressing` collection with an entry apron, walkways, a nearby road strip, lawn beds, and generic trees/shrubs. This gives the render campus scale without fabricating a detailed CoRec building. Its local layout is approximate, not georeferenced or surveyed; master integration may hide this collection if shared roads/landscaping already exist.
Added a second interior presentation with facade/windows visible and roof/context hidden to give the seating view architectural context.
validation: Freshly reopened and rendered in Blender 5.2.3; validation passed. GIS FID 896 bidirectional boundary comparison remains 70 edges per side, max sampled error 0.000002m in each direction. This validates only local footprint correspondence, not height, survey position, or master registration. 70 mapped masonry faces, 57 ribbon panes, 86 seam splines, 288 seats, 12 aisle treads, 24 split step sections, 21 optional site-context objects, all meshes materialed, no external image dependencies. Published dive depth/platform levels retained.
uncertainties: Roof pitch, roof/eave/ridge heights and materials are unmeasured; standing seams are a plausible finish treatment only.
Exact facade bay proportions and sign scale are unmeasured.
The seating aisle, seat arrangement, gallery geometry, and added site dressing are schematic.
The optional site collection is not georeferenced; road, landscaping, and tree positions are not as-built claims.
GIS outline alignment does not establish master placement.
